description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git configurations related to user email and name settings during repository operations such as commit, clone, and rebase. It sets up various scenarios to ensure Git behaves correctly when user identification information varies or is overridden by environment variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a provided shell command.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures Git settings for user or author information.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message or content.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a command to run after the test finishes, typically for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are the same.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables or Git configurations in a safe manner.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
